question: Burn, EXCEPT
question_ar: جميع الجمل المتعلقة بالحرق صحيحة باستثناء؟

options.text: Full-thickness burns extend into deep reticular dermis, yellow-white appearance, fairly dry texture, painful, needs 3-8 weeks for healing
Burn areas can be calculated by the Rule of Nines
Fluid resuscitation is calculated based on the burn area
Intravenous fluid resuscitation is necessary in a child with 10% partial thickness burn
Prophylactic intubation could be necessary in inhalation burns

correct_text: Full-thickness burns extend into deep reticular dermis, yellow-white appearance, fairly dry texture, painful, needs 3-8 weeks for healing
